name: utopia-tms
description: Utopia Fulfillment Inc — Transportation Management System
//type: Required for the Vercel function. `api/index.ts` sits at the repo root,
outside every workspace, so its module format is decided by THIS file.
Without it Vercel compiles the function to CommonJS while server/ stays
ESM, and the deployed API dies on every request with ERR_REQUIRE_ESM —
a 500 that the local dev server, which is ESM throughout, never shows.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm -w server run dev" "npm -w client run dev"
scripts.build: npm -w shared run build && npm -w server run build && npm -w client run build
scripts.build:vercel: npm -w shared run build && npm -w client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w shared run typecheck && npm -w server run typecheck && npm -w client run typecheck
